🧠 Dreamland

"Not a search engine. A wish engine."

Wish → Resonance → Result
Dreamland doesn't look for exact URLs. It takes a wish (a rhythm, a phase, a pattern) and finds the closest matching wave in the network. If no exact source exists, it composes a temporary result from nearby wave spaces.
Precision & Ingenuity
High precision: "I want exactly this page."
High ingenuity: "Find me something that satisfies this need, even if it doesn't exist yet."
